review_comments: I'm not really sure what the purpose of this test scene is. It asserts nothing, it doesn't really do anything besides smoke testing that the component just doesn't outright crash (which will also be covered by all the other comment test scenes, presumably).
There's nothing really to test, but, as being said, each component should have a test scene.
now that you moved the icon toggling logic to the base there is arguably something to test.
We have multiple colour changes here, not only for background. Either way we will override `OnHover` and `OnHoverLost`
you wouldn't have to manually add the `HoverClickSounds` that way, but sure, I suppose.
